n_eval_types=4 (clean-set accuracy/error, backdoor-set accuracy/attack success rate, convolutional-filter/activation visualization analysis, online-repository security audit); the real-world physical Post-it demonstration was treated as an instance of the backdoor-accuracy evaluation rather than a separate eval type.
n_baselines=0: the paper only compares BadNets against an honestly-trained (clean) reference network of identical architecture, not against any competing prior attack method.
